title: Quest = a story-driven multi-step activity (quests/<id>.json). One instance = (quest, seed): variables are drawn once and shared by all steps.

experience.description: Index into stages[].experiences of curriculum.json: the official 'doświadczenie edukacyjne' this quest realises
